name: Haiyore! Nyaruko-san  Meijou Shigatai Game no You na Mono
original_name: 這いよれ！ニャル子さん 名状しがたいゲームのようなもの
source:
A game based a light novel by Aisora Manta and illustrated by Koin.

The story of Haiyore! Nyaruko-san centers around Nyaruko, a formless Cthulhu-deity of chaos (Nyarlathotep) who can take on the shape of a seemingly ordinary silver-haired girl. Yasaka Mahiro is a normal high school boy who is being chased by a fearsome black alien one night, until Nyaruko saves him. She explains that the creatures from H. P. Lovecraft's works are actually races of aliens, and that she has been sent to Earth to protect him from being kidnapped by an alien trafficker. Eventually, Nyaruko and two other Lovecraft-creatures, Cthugha and Hastur, end up being freeloaders at Mahiro's place.


[Taken from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2012-03-05/crunchyroll-to-stream-haiyore-nyaruko-san-tv-anime]Anime News Network[/url]]
translation:
本作改编自逢空万太创作、狐印插画的轻小说。

《潜行吧！奈亚子》的故事围绕奈亚子展开。她是一个无形的克苏鲁混沌神祇（奈亚拉托提普），可以变成看似普通的银发少女。八坂真寻是一名普通的高中男生，一天夜里被可怕的黑色外星人追赶，直到奈亚子救了他。

她解释说，H·P·洛夫克拉夫特作品中的生物其实都是外星种族，而她被派到地球，是为了保护真寻不被外星人口贩子绑架。最后，奈亚子以及另外两名洛夫克拉夫特生物克图格亚和哈斯塔，成了真寻家里的寄生虫。

[取自 [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2012-03-05/crunchyroll-to-stream-haiyore-nyaruko-san-tv-anime]Anime News Network[/url]]
